question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sluggish
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sluggish"** means moving slowly or lacking energy. (सुस्त)

 
 
• **Example:** After the long meeting, I felt too **sluggish** to do any more work.
 
 
 
• **"Rapid"** refers to something that happens quickly or in a short amount of time. (तेज़)
 
 
• **Example:** The rapid growth of technology has changed our lives significantly.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Sluggish' **is **'Rapid'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lethargic** (सुस्त): Feeling sluggish and lacking in energy.

 
 
• **Example:** The hot weather made everyone feel lethargic.
 
 
 
• **Leisurely** (आराम से): Acting or done at a relaxed pace.
 
 
• **Example:** We took a leisurely stroll around the park.
 
 
 
• **Hassled** (परेशान): Feeling stressed or harassed.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt hassled by the constant demands of her job.
